decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( SW/001/10, SW001/02, SW001/01 and Design and Access Statement. Received: 30th November 2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side or rear walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The hereby approved outbuilding including barbeque area shall only be used for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 22 Francis Avenue, Feltham, TW13 4EB and shall not be used for commercial purposes or for self-contained residential purposes and shall not contain primary living accommodation, including a bedroom or bathroom at any time for the duration of the development
description: Retrospective application for the erection of a detached single storey outbuilding to the rear
